svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the foam to the insole outline.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a window round each pressure sensor and its tail, 0.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clear all round: lay the sensors on the foam and trace round them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a window at the heel, 16 mm long and 34 mm wide, for the tail

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end and its eight pads, and a notch 11 mm wide at the heel edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a small window for the motor leads beside the motor, and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 x 10 mm window over the crossover patch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not cut over the motor: its top sticks to this foam.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lay it over the carrier with the windows round the sensors;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its adhesive side down. Nothing in a window may stand proud of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
